text: {"frames":["Edith the learned owl from the mill bets you a warm waffle that the drowned bell will ring before the tide turns. The fog over the canal smells of wet tar and old herring, and far below the bell tolls once, low and wrong. The sluice gate under the Tower's first floor has stuck at 0.59 of its full opening, and Edith says the bell rope only comes free when you know exactly how much of the gate is already open. She clicks her beak and waits for you to answer. What percentage is 0.59?","\"Nobody has ever seen the watchman on the dyke by day,\" says Gareth, and she holds up a jar of grey fog to the lamp. Since autumn she has collected fog in jars, and this one is filled to 0.59 of its height. The silent watchman only steps out of the wall when the fog is measured truly, and Gareth has a bet with him that she can do it. The dyke creaks behind you, and a cold draught slides from the jar. What percentage is 0.59?","The crooked house with the hoist beam has every window glowing, yet the door is locked from inside and nobody is home. Then the beam swings loose and a wheel of cheese rolls out over the canal ice, and the cheesemaker's apprentice runs after it shouting. The lamps in the windows are burning at 0.59 of their brightness, and the glow has to be matched before the ice takes the cheese. The apprentice thrusts a slate at you with the number on it. What percentage is 0.59?","The clock in the Tower strikes thirteen, and the thirteenth stroke is so loud that the windmills stop turning. Nell with the blue lantern grabs your sleeve and says the hour does not exist, so the stairs have started to climb the wrong way. Her lantern gives light at 0.59 of its strength, and she must find the true share before the next stroke comes. The stairs begin to rustle under your feet, and Nell is already running. What percentage is 0.59?","Luuk the old lock keeper has been waiting by the book in the Tower since dawn, because it writes itself and he wants to read the line before the lock closes. The ink spreads across the page: the canal is frozen over 0.59 of its length, and the rest is still open water. Luuk taps his pipe and says the book only lets you read the figure when you turn it into a share of the whole. He is hungry and he is in a hurry. What percentage is 0.59?"]}
